manifest.display_name: Kokoro v1.0 INT8 English stock voices (Windows CPU)
manifest.description: Optional explicit-download Kokoro-82M v1.0 INT8 speech-synthesis pack using the pinned sherpa-onnx 1.13.6 Windows x64 C runtime. It exposes 28 fixed American and British English stock voices and streams 24 kHz mono PCM. API TTS remains the default. Local activation is blocked until catalog trust, license acceptance, a real Windows self-test attestation, signed current-device measurements, and whole-loadout admission all pass.
